$comment: Provisional: the reference definition of the implementation guide (Section 11.4), from the kinds and attributes of [FW] Section 3.6, stands in for [IMPL] Annex B until it arrives; work item D.3 replaces it.
title: ControlParameterEntry
description: A control parameter: its class of managed object, its value, the controller bindings that set it and how it is read back.

owner.description: The owner of the entry: the domain owner, framework or kpi-definitions.

deprecated.description: A deprecated entry stays resolvable; admission warns new descriptors.

setBy.description: The controller bindings that set the parameter.

provenance.description: Where the entry's content comes from.

families.description: What the parameter acts on in each product family the driver supports.

method.description: The verification method that reads the parameter back: msObservation or controllerQuery.

metric.description: The metric that reports the parameter, for msObservation.
